## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- Standard partition filter
WHERE grass_region IN ('ID','SG','MY','TH','VN','PH','TW','BR')
  AND grass_date = date('${grass_date}')

-- Click-only requests (most PCOC analysis)
  AND click_cnt > 0
  AND user_id > 0
  AND item_id > 0
  AND ads_id > 0

-- Deduplicated click requests
  AND deduplicated_click > 0

-- Has valid model prediction
  AND uni_pcr_model_name != ''
  AND uni_pcr_model_name IS NOT NULL

-- Has pGMV prediction (for hasscore calibration)
  AND CAST(get_json_object(bid_rerank_trace, '$.direct_pgmv_7d') AS DOUBLE) > 0

-- Exclude specific model version
  AND uni_pcr_model_name != 'gpu_newdatav1_id'

-- ROI2.0 / Target ROI
  AND pricing_type IN (11)

-- Placement filter
  AND entrance IN (1,3,4,8,9,10,11,29,33,34)
  AND placement IN (40, 50)
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- PCOC computation (most common pattern): SUM(prediction) / SUM(label)
-- Direct pGMV PCOC
SUM(CAST(get_json_object(bid_rerank_trace, '$.direct_pgmv_7d') AS DOUBLE))
  / NULLIF(SUM(direct_gmv_amt_local), 0) AS direct_pcoc

-- Shop pGMV PCOC (shop = broad - direct)
SUM(CAST(get_json_object(bid_rerank_trace, '$.shop_pgmv_7d') AS DOUBLE))
  / NULLIF(SUM(broad_gmv_amt_local - direct_gmv_amt_local), 0) AS shop_pcoc

-- Broad pGMV PCOC
SUM(CAST(get_json_object(bid_rerank_trace, '$.broad_pgmv_7d') AS DOUBLE))
  / NULLIF(SUM(broad_gmv_amt_local), 0) AS broad_pcoc

-- Final pGMV PCOC (post-processed)
SUM(CAST(get_json_object(bid_rerank_trace, '$.pgmv') AS DOUBLE))
  / NULLIF(SUM(broad_gmv_amt_local), 0) AS final_pcoc

-- CR PCOC
SUM(pcr_xx) / SUM(direct_order_cnt_1h)

-- Feedback ratio calibration
-- pGMV_1h = pgmv_7d * feedback_ratio_1h
SUM(CAST(get_json_object(bid_rerank_trace, '$.broad_pgmv_7d') AS DOUBLE)
  * CAST(get_json_object(bid_rerank_trace, '$.feedback_ratio_1h') AS DOUBLE)) AS broad_pgmv_1h_sum

-- GROUP BY dimensions (calibration): item_id, campaign_id, shop_id, cate1, cate2, entrance, placement, pricing_type, grass_region, grass_date
-- GROUP BY dimensions (PCOC monitor): entrance, placement, grass_region, grass_date
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: Click-level PCOC monitoring (clk_pcoc_monitor)

```sql
-- Scheduled task: monitors daily pGMV PCOC by entrance/placement
-- Engine: Presto
WITH clk_base AS (
    SELECT
        grass_region, grass_date,
        CASE WHEN entrance = 1 THEN 'search'
             WHEN entrance = 3 THEN 'dd'
             WHEN entrance = 4 THEN 'ymal'
             WHEN entrance IN (8,9,10,11) THEN 'pp'
             ELSE 'video' END AS entrance,
        CASE WHEN placement = 40 THEN 'target'
             WHEN placement = 50 THEN 'simple' END AS placement,
        direct_gmv_amt_local,
        broad_gmv_amt_local - direct_gmv_amt_local AS shop_gmv_amt_local,
        CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(bid_rerank_trace, '$.direct_pgmv_7d') AS DOUBLE)/100000 AS direct_pgmv_7d,
        CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(bid_rerank_trace, '$.shop_pgmv_7d') AS DOUBLE)/100000 AS shop_pgmv_7d,
        CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(bid_rerank_trace, '$.pgmv') AS DOUBLE)/100000 AS final_pgmv
    FROM mp_paidads.dwd_ads_request_performance_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('${-7d}') AND date('${-1d}')
      AND grass_region IN ('SG','VN','MY','TH','TW','PH')
      AND entrance IN (1,3,4,8,9,10,11,29,33,34)
      AND placement IN (40, 50)
      AND CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(bid_rerank_trace, '$.direct_pcr_7d') AS DOUBLE) > 0.0
      AND uni_pcr_model_name != '' AND uni_pcr_model_name IS NOT NULL
      AND user_id > 0 AND item_id > 0 AND click_cnt > 0
)
SELECT entrance, placement,
    SUM(1) AS click_cnt,
    ROUND(SUM(direct_pgmv_7d) / NULLIF(SUM(direct_gmv_amt_local), 0), 2) AS direct_pcoc,
    ROUND(SUM(final_pgmv) / NULLIF(SUM(broad_gmv_amt_local), 0), 2) AS final_pcoc,
    grass_region, grass_date
FROM clk_base GROUP BY entrance, placement, grass_region, grass_date
```

### Snippet 2: Item-level calibration features (feedback_ratio_for_cali)

```sql
-- Workflow: extracts item-level features for model calibration
-- Engine: SparkSQL
SELECT
    item_id, campaign_id, shop_id,
    level1_global_be_category_id AS cate1,
    entrance, placement, pricing_type,
    COUNT(1) AS click_cnt,
    SUM(COALESCE(broad_order_cnt, 0)) AS broad_order_cnt_7d,
    SUM(COALESCE(direct_order_cnt_1h, 0)) AS direct_order_cnt_1h,
    SUM(COALESCE(broad_gmv_amt_local, 0)) AS broad_gmv_7d,
    SUM(COALESCE(direct_gmv_amt_local, 0)) AS direct_gmv_7d,
    SUM(COALESCE(CAST(get_json_object(bid_rerank_trace, '$.direct_pgmv_7d') AS DOUBLE), 0)) AS direct_pgmv_7d_sum,
    SUM(COALESCE(CAST(get_json_object(bid_rerank_trace, '$.feedback_ratio_1h') AS DOUBLE), 0)) AS pred_fr_1h_sum,
    SUM(COALESCE(item_price, 0)) AS pred_item_price_sum,
    grass_region, grass_date
FROM mp_paidads.dwd_ads_request_performance_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region IN ('ID','SG','MY','TH','VN','PH','TW','BR')
  AND deduplicated_click > 0
  AND CAST(get_json_object(bid_rerank_trace, '$.direct_pgmv_7d') AS DOUBLE) > 0
  AND user_id > 0 AND item_id > 0
GROUP BY item_id, campaign_id, shop_id, level1_global_be_category_id,
    level2_global_be_category_id, entrance, placement, pricing_type,
    grass_region, grass_date
```

### Snippet 3: Voucher uplift model evaluation (uplift_daily_report)

```sql
-- Workflow: evaluates uplift model scores at different discount levels
-- Engine: SparkSQL
WITH raw_base AS (
    SELECT
        a.grass_region, CAST(a.grass_date AS STRING) AS grass_date,
        CASE WHEN a.entrance IN (1) THEN 'search'
             WHEN a.entrance IN (3) THEN 'dd'
             WHEN a.entrance IN (4) THEN 'yaml'
             WHEN a.entrance IN (8,9,10,11) THEN 'pp'
             ELSE 'other' END AS entrance,
        CAST(a.direct_order_cnt_1h AS DOUBLE) AS direct_order_cnt_1h,
        CAST(get_json_object(a.bid_rerank_trace, '$.uplift_pcr0') AS DOUBLE) AS uplift_pcr0,
        CAST(get_json_object(a.bid_rerank_trace, '$.uplift_pcr_ratio2') AS DOUBLE) AS uplift_pcr_ratio2,
        split(get_json_object(a.bid_rerank_trace, '$.uplift_model_score_str'), ',') AS uplift_model_score_parts,
        CAST(get_json_object(a.bid_rerank_trace, '$.voucher_price') AS DOUBLE) AS voucher_price_raw,
        CAST(get_json_object(a.bid_rerank_trace, '$.voucher_unpicked_reason') AS BIGINT) AS voucher_unpicked_reason,
        a.avg_sold_cnt_item, a.item_price, a.target_cir,
        CAST(a.direct_order_gmv_local_1h AS DOUBLE) AS direct_order_gmv_local_1h
    FROM mp_paidads.dwd_ads_request_performance_di__reg_s0_live AS a
    WHERE a.grass_region IN ('TH','VN','PH','TW','SG','MY','BR')
      AND a.ads_id > 0 AND a.user_id > 0 AND a.click_cnt > 0
)
```

### Snippet 4: ROI3 voucher discount performance (roi3_monitor)

```sql
-- Scheduled task: monitors ROI3 voucher experiment performance by discount tier
-- Engine: Presto
SELECT t.*,
    CAST(json_extract_scalar(bid_rerank_trace, '$.voucher_price') AS DOUBLE) AS voucher_price,
    CAST(json_extract_scalar(bid_rerank_trace, '$.voucher_price') AS DOUBLE) / item_price / 1e5 AS discount_rate,
    CAST(json_extract_scalar(bid_rerank_trace, '$.isRoi3') AS BOOLEAN) AS is_roi3,
    CAST(json_extract_scalar(bid_rerank_trace, '$["pcr_v"]') AS DOUBLE) AS bid_pcr_v
FROM mp_paidads.dwd_ads_request_performance_di__reg_s0_live t
JOIN mp_paidads.dim_advertiser_roi3_whitelist__reg_s0_live w
  ON t.grass_region = w.grass_region AND t.grass_date = w.grass_date AND t.shop_id = w.shop_id
WHERE t.grass_date = date('${-1d}') AND t.grass_region IN ('ID')
  AND ads_id > 0 AND pricing_type IN (11)
```

## Write Lineage (生产血缘)

### Main Production Workflow

- **Path:** `data_paidadsmart/workflows/data_warehouse/dwd/trace/dwd_ads_request_performance_di__reg_s0_live/`
- **Schedule:** Daily
- **Two-phase write:**
  1. **Phase 1 (INSERT OVERWRITE):** Aggregates from `mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_hi__reg_s0_live` grouped by (ads_id, campaign_id, item_id, user_id, request_id, shop_id, entrance, pricing_type, placement). Writes click/impression counts, model scores, voucher info. Filters: `operation IN (1,2,3) AND fraud_type = '' AND ads_id > 0`.
  2. **Phase 2 (MERGE INTO):** Merges order attribution data (deduct_click, expenditure, order counts, GMV) from `mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_hi__reg_s0_live` OA events. Also joins `mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live` for USD conversion.
- **Region variants:**
  - UTC8 regions (ID, SG, MY, PH, TW): `grass_date = grass_date` directly
  - TH: timezone conversion from UTC+08 to Asia/Bangkok
  - VN: timezone conversion from UTC+08 to Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh
  - Latin (BR, AR, CL, CO, MX): timezone conversion from UTC+08 to respective timezone

### US Production Workflow

- **Path:** `data_paidadsmart/workflows/data_warehouse_us/dwd/dwd_ads_request_performance_di__reg_s0_live_us/`
- Same logic, covers BR and AR regions

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

| Metric | Formula | Usage |
|--------|---------|-------|
| direct_pcoc | SUM(direct_pgmv_7d) / SUM(direct_gmv_amt_local) | Model calibration accuracy |
| shop_pcoc | SUM(shop_pgmv_7d) / SUM(broad_gmv_amt_local - direct_gmv_amt_local) | Shop-level model accuracy |
| broad_pcoc | SUM(broad_pgmv_7d) / SUM(broad_gmv_amt_local) | Broad model accuracy |
| final_pcoc | SUM(pgmv) / SUM(broad_gmv_amt_local) | End-to-end model accuracy |
| discount_rate | voucher_price / item_price / 1e5 | Voucher discount percentage |
| shop_gmv | broad_gmv_amt_local - direct_gmv_amt_local | Shop-attributed GMV (broad minus direct) |
| shop_order | broad_order_cnt - direct_order_cnt | Shop-attributed orders |
| pred_gmv_xx | pcr_xx * avg_sold_cnt_item * item_price | Predicted GMV at discount level xx |
| pred_advv_xx | pred_gmv_xx * target_cir | Predicted advertiser value at discount level xx |
| pGMV_1h | pgmv_7d * feedback_ratio_1h | 1-hour predicted GMV |

*Note: pGMV values in bid_rerank_trace are stored at 1e5 scale (multiply by 100000 to match local currency). Presto extracts use `/100000`, SparkSQL uses raw values depending on downstream formula.*
